entities.summary: Ushaw College is a former Roman Catholic seminary near the village of Ushaw Moor, County Durham, in Northeast England. Until 2011 was also a licensed hall of residence of Durham University. It is now a heritage and cultural tourist attraction. The campus is known for its Georgian and Victorian Gothic architecture and listed nineteenth-century chapels. It now hosts a programme of art exhibitions, music and theatre events, alongside tearooms and a café.
